description: 3D and media-creation builds: meshes, scenes, render pipelines and exports, gated by render/preview checks, an export probe and a poly budget instead of lint/typecheck/tests.

add.instructions: Produce the 3D/media asset per the plan (TRELLIS/Text-to-CAD/Blender/OpenMontage as applicable). Write production_artifacts/03_creation.md and the state.d fragment.

gates.render-preview: A render or preview of the asset exists and matches the plan's look brief (scene info read back, start frame and gens sane)
gates.export-probe: Every export passes its probe: ffprobe on video exports, glTF/glb sanity on meshes — the file exists at the asked dimensions/format
gates.poly-budget: The mesh stays within the plan's poly budget, decimated per pb-image-to-3d if it exceeded it

selection.description: Pick when the goal is producing a 3D asset or media artifact: meshes, renders, exports, timelines.

notes: The creator node reuses the godmode-media-eventtech agent and persona; no dedicated creator agent exists in .claude/agents/. The three gates mirror pb-image-to-3d's poly budget and the ffprobe check pb-social-pack/pb-launch-video run. Known persona gap: nodes need Blender/media MCP servers (mesh/render probes), which no persona file covers yet.
